extraction.Name: Alsa E. Allen
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area implied)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but accepted it on the advice of the Farmer and Superintendent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her land to the State of South Dakota for $1000.00
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the State of South Dakota for $1000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he is keeping up the payments and taxes
extraction.NOTES: Affidavit sworn by Charles Allen, husband of Alsa E. Allen, deceased. Alsa E. Allen died February 8, 1920. Affidavit taken November 26, 1928. Charles Allen is maintaining mortgage payments and taxes on the land.
